_comment: IG-IPC-CONTRACT · Canonical registry of every Tauri command. LOCKED 2026-07-20. Every command must appear here, be registered in generate_handler!, AND be either invoked from src/ or explicitly marked internal:true. See src/lib/ipcContractAudit.test.ts for enforcement.

secret_get_jwt.notes: Read license JWT from macOS Keychain. Called only by authStorage.ts.

secret_set_jwt.notes: Write license JWT to Keychain. Called only by authStorage.ts (auth-action only).

secret_delete_jwt.notes: Delete Keychain entry. Called only by authStorage.ts.

openai_key_get.notes: Reserved · not yet consumed by frontend. Kept for parity with set/delete.

openai_key_set.notes: Persist OPENAI_API_KEY to Keychain. Called from Settings.tsx.

openai_key_delete.notes: Remove OPENAI_API_KEY from Keychain. Called from Settings.tsx.

sidecar_call.notes: Opaque JSON-RPC bridge to Python sidecar. Inner shape validated by sidecar.

sidecar_log_read.notes: Return the tail of the sidecar log for diagnostics.

sidecar_log_open.notes: Reveal sidecar log in Finder. Called from IntroSplash on repair path.

sidecar_repair.notes: Restart the sidecar host process. Called from IntroSplash.

open_browse_panel.notes: Spawn native WKWebView child window at coords.

webview_eval.notes: Evaluate JS inside the browse-panel webview. Called from gmailComposeBridge.ts.

runtime_info.notes: Version + bundle metadata for the runtime update system.

runtime_check_now.notes: Force a runtime manifest fetch. Called from UpdateBeacon + Settings.

stash_upload.notes: Upload thumbnail identity image to identity stash.

screen_capture_support_status.notes: Serde field names snake_case; frontend adapter camelCases at nativeCapture.ts:60.

screen_capture_start.notes: Frontend uses camelCase key; Rust arg is session_id (Tauri auto-maps).
